_about: Hand tags. tuning: 8 papers (5 x 9709, 3 x 9702) read part by part while developing the rules. round2: 4 papers labelled blind (cleaned text only, before looking at tagger output); first score was primary 111/128 = 86.7%, question type 100/128 = 78.1%, 9709 sim 26/32 = 81.2%; their errors were then analysed and general rules added, so they now count as tuning data. heldout: 4 more papers labelled blind AFTER the rules were frozen; never used for tuning. primary = main topic of the part; tags = all topics whose techniques earn marks; qtype = question type id (question-level grouping: e.g. any part of a vehicle question that involves power is vehicle-power, a bare suvat step inside a dynamics question takes that question type); sim = 9709 sim id.
